result.description: Compact USB-C studio keyboard designed for live coding, DAW shortcuts, and macro-heavy workflows. Features low-profile mechanical switches, per-key RGB zoning, a detachable braided cable, and onboard profile storage for five custom layouts. The aluminum top plate and damped stabilizers are tuned for quiet operation in shared workspaces.
